content_html:
I’ve decided it’s time to have a little more fun on X this year! 😄⚡ I get to speak at some amazing events, meet fascinating people, hear great stories, and occasionally find myself in places I never expected to be. So I figured… why not share some of those moments here? And there’s more! I’m also excited to launch my new merch. A little Woz spirit, a little fun, and hopefully a few things bring a smile to your face. This is just the beginning. More adventures, more stories, and more surprises to come!
